changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE competition_periods ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, period_unit TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DAY', periods_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 7, started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL );
CREATE INDEX matches_period_idx ON matches (period_id, period_day);

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE matches DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS period_id, DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS period_day;
